unmappedForReview.detail: Ticket expected ~56 URLs from a 279-vs-223 post sitemap comparison. Live Yoast post-sitemap is already 223 locs (hub + 222 posts), matching the new site. Wayback Machine snapshots through 2026-01 also sit at ~215–223 locs. Remaining ~33 URLs from the 279 figure are not in any current public sitemap, WP REST posts, or in-repo permalinks. Provide Search Console / Screaming Frog rows for those paths before launch if they still receive traffic.
